description: Owner decision 6 dormancy gate: the packaged host capabilities while the paid tier is off. Both packages/core (accessCapabilities) and StillKit (NativeAccessContext's default supported set) must equal this list exactly, so no Still Pro feature can resolve to an effective state while paid is off. The paid-on Safari sets are per Apple platform: StillKit's NativeAppleAccessCapabilities for macOS (desktop layouts) and for iPhone/iPad must equal packages/core accessCapabilities for host safari with platform desktop and ios.
